passage: Speaker A: Is the conference worth attending?
question: Speaker B: Make a sentence using all the words: / on / depends / in / it / are interested / you / which sessions /
answer: It depends on which sessions you are interested in.
model_answer: It depends on which sessions you are interested in.
explanation: 【間接疑問】間接疑問（when / whether / how など）の 中は 疑問文の 語順に せず「疑問詞＋主語＋動詞」の 平叙文の 語順に する。正解：It depends on which sessions you are interested in.
